messages:
maya: quick update — rolled kernel-selection v2 to 7% canary around 12:07 UTC. saw early perf spike on long-seq workloads.
sam: seen +8-12% p95 tail on tests that hit KV cache misses. repro in perf-ci: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/9876
perf-bot: [ALERT] perf-ci/regressions detected for job runtime-smoke at 1715067895 — p95 +11% vs baseline
li: bisected to PR #4523 (selector heuristics) — suspect the 'prefer-lazy-prefetch' diff. local bisect -> merge 9f3c2a4
maya: interesting — that PR changed batching hint to prefer smaller batches when prefetch misses > 0
natalie: can we pause rollout? current gate is time-based only
maya: +1 pause. Also looks like KV prefetch is warming slower causing more cold misses; kernel choice path amplifies tail
ops-bot: deploy-bot paused rollout at 7% (manual). see /deploy status: canary halted
sam: perf-ci also shows reruns with synthetic long sequences spike the most. attached logs:
```
p95 baseline: 48ms
p95 canary: 53-57ms
hot path: kv_fetch -> kernel_select -> execute
```
li: quick mitigation options:
- revert PR 4523
- change kernel-selection to fallback-to-stable on kv_miss
- tighten canary gating to require perf delta < +3% for 30m
maya: prefer fallback + gate so we don't revert perf improvements for other cases
natalie: propose adding automatic rollback rule in rollout controller:
```
automatic_rollback:
  metric: runtime_p95
  window: 15m
  threshold: +5%
  min_samples: 500
  action: rollback-to-stable
```
ops-bot: ok can implement. also suggest an early "smoke" test at 1% traffic that runs profiler and KV hit-rate check before increasing canary.
perf-bot: note: CI currently doesn't simulate cold-KV warmup; we should add synthetic cold-warm sequences to perf suite.
sam: i'll open followups — add test + revert patch candidate in case controller change is delayed
maya: filing playbook task for on-call: steps to triage if rollback triggers, include diagnostics to collect:
- kernel selection trace
- kv-miss histogram
- batch-size distribution
li: after rollback, let's run micro-bench with kernel v2 + forced cache-warmup to measure real diff
natalie: i'll draft rollout config PR with gate + smoke step and automatic_rollback YAML
maya: thanks. keeping this thread pinned for immediate ops. :warning:
deploy-bot: canary paused by maya at 1715067955
perf-bot: created issue perf/regression-4523 with links to bisect and logs
